mintAuthority.summary: USD3 is a Reserve Protocol Yield RToken/DTF: anyone can permissionlessly mint by depositing the governed collateral basket and redeem for it. Ethereum native issuance uses an upgradeable Main proxy whose OWNER_ROLE is held by Reserve governance through a 3-day TimelockController; the Base deployment is a bridge representation and is excluded from native Mint Authority. A 3/5 guardian Safe can cancel Ethereum timelock proposals.

controls.label: USD3 RToken mint/redeem (BasketHandler)
controls.capDescription: Permissionless mint requires depositing the full governed collateral basket in proportion; mint/redeem are throttled by protocol issuance/redemption rate limits.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531015, USD3 RToken.main() returned 0x81117e3e98910C3dCF956b5Fc97a7212E047AcF4 (Main proxy), Main.rToken() returned 0x0d86883FAf4FfD7aEb116390af37746F45b6F378, Main.basketHandler() returned 0x19835E5817A6fDC944100E86da2FCe86327457B8, and frozen()=false / issuancePaused()=false. The Main proxy implementation slot returned verified MainP1 0xc5bf686cfb85786fcfff557297d4aff8f4e15e44.

controls.label: Governor Anastasius → TimelockController (OWNER_ROLE on Main)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531015, Main.OWNER_ROLE() returned bytes32('OWNER') and Main.hasRole(OWNER_ROLE, 0x848b923b5d99d5963608ff55acdfee51c443cca6) returned true. TimelockController.getMinDelay() returned 259200 seconds (3 days). Governor Anastasius 0xd895a5d391fc09f12e8c8d57cfde5c59bfbe2fa7 remains the USD3 stRSR governor through Governor.token() = 0x55230B05d4c1F4a0B4f804dc52919F06355DfBF8; the existing guardian Safe 0xd5fe2780eb882d1da78f2136b81c2a4395488c98 remains the cancellation authority.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770459, USD3 Main proxy 0x81117e3e98910C3dCF956b5Fc97a7212E047AcF4 had implementation 0xc5bf686cfb85786fcfff557297d4aff8f4e15e44; Main.OWNER_ROLE() was held by TimelockController 0x848b923b5d99d5963608ff55acdfee51c443cca6, whose getMinDelay() returned 259200 seconds. Main.rToken() and Main.basketHandler() identify the Ethereum USD3 and BasketHandler, and the Reserve issuance system was not paused or frozen at the authored observation. Governor Anastasius remains the stRSR governance path and the existing 3/5 guardian Safe remains the Ethereum timelock cancellation authority. Ethereum native issuance requires the governed collateral basket; the Base representation's bridge-mint capability is excluded from this native review and is scored separately under Bridge Risk. Changing Reserve issuance economics or mint logic traverses the three-day governance timelock. The native path is therefore economically raiseable, not unbounded, and no named supervisor or independent attestor applies.
